            when --rceus is set.

        --dump-call-graph <call-graph-output>
            Dump the call graph in DOT format to the output file.

        --dump-mir <mir-output>
            Dump the mir of reachable functions to the output file.

        --dump-pts <pts-output>
            Dump points-to results to the output file.

            Dump the statistics of the analysis results.

        --dump-unsafe-stats <unsafe-stats-output>
            Dump the statistics of unsafe functions in the analyzed program.

        --entry-func <entry-func-name>
            The name of entry function from which the pointer analysis begins.

        --entry-id <entry-func-id>
            The def_id of entry function from which the pointer analysis begins.

    -h, --help

            Enable rceus in pointer analysis.
